status: Source reconciled and software cases passed; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
scope: One staged protocol and its audit evidence only; active v0.84.38 checkout unchanged

before_comparison.interpretation: Failed expectations include newly introduced capabilities and provenance, not a count of separate clinical defects. Source-criterion witness assertions apply only to the candidate.

source_pdf_table_visual_check: NCCP page 4 rendered and inspected; table boundaries/conjunctions checked against raw text

findings.before: Every hypertension grade ≥3 triggered discontinuation despite prose requiring persisting grade 3.
findings.after: Grade 2–3 triggers therapy/review; explicit persistence or grade 4 triggers discontinuation.

findings.before: The legacy >200/110 boolean produced discontinuation without this threshold appearing in NCCP 00813.
findings.after: Urgent hold/review preserves safety; separate crisis, unresponsive medically significant hypertension, and source-defined initiation checks govern outcomes.

findings.before: A 2+/3+ dipstick could repeatedly permit proceeding without distinguishing the next dose after an abnormal screen.
findings.after: Initial/routine screen, next dose after abnormal screen, and post-hold reassessment are distinct. Required quantification and the three-day collection window are explicit.

findings.topic: Distinct urine units and quantitative boundaries
findings.before: No separate urine concentration input; screening and quantitative timing/validity were incomplete.
findings.after: g/L screening is separate from g/24 h total. Tests cover 1 g/L, ≤2, >2–4, >4 g/24 h, invalid/absent collection confirmation and discordant results.

findings.before: No source-specific prior-stop history was available.
findings.after: Prior stop reasons remain active despite normal BP, urine or grade values. No automatic restart or invented lower dose is supplied.

findings.before: Quantitative >4 g/24 h alone did not cover the independent grade 4/nephrotic pathway.
findings.after: Explicit clinician-confirmed source grade 4 proteinuria and nephrotic syndrome checks remain actionable independently of a lower numerical result.

findings.before: Only generic grade 4 fistula was assessed.
findings.after: Any-grade tracheoesophageal fistula triggers permanent discontinuation; other internal fistulae require consideration of discontinuation.

findings.before: One compound boolean did not expose the interval/healing conjunction.
findings.after: <28 days, incomplete healing and wound complications independently withhold. ≥28 days without healing confirmation cannot clear treatment. Elective surgery timing remains individualised.

findings.topic: Bleeding site and current versus historical thrombosis
findings.before: Generic grades did not cover current intracranial bleeding or recent haemoptysis, and arterial history could be confused with a new event.
findings.after: Intracranial bleeding, >2.5 mL red-blood haemoptysis, new arterial events, lower-grade VTE and source-specific major bleeding actions are separated.

findings.before: Recurrent glioblastoma context/organ adequacy were not assessed explicitly and breastfeeding was omitted.
findings.after: Exact indication and clinical organ adequacy are reviewed without fabricated ANC/platelet thresholds; breastfeeding is an exclusion. Existing ECOG/imaging/ICH/stroke exclusions are retained.

findings.topic: Infusion and suspected acute neurological events
findings.before: Confirmed PRES existed; acute infusion reaction and suspected neurological concern were absent.
findings.after: Stop the active infusion and treat reactions; urgent hold/review for new neurological symptoms. Confirmed PRES stops therapy and restart safety remains unknown.
findings.source: EMA pp6,8; urgent clinical assessment interpretation

findings.before: Required monitoring and conditional cardiac/INR considerations were not decision inputs.
findings.after: FBC/renal/liver/urine checks, BP before and after treatment, conditional ECHO and warfarin INR timing are explicit. Minimal emetic risk and no routine premedication are preserved.

findings.before: Several cautions were not available to the decision tool.
findings.after: Cardiovascular, renal/proteinuria, bleeding/clotting, pelvic RT/perforation, aneurysm, dental/IV bisphosphonate and interaction concerns are review pathways.

findings.before: Standard schedule was prose-only and actions had no explicit numeric-modification guard.
findings.after: Structured 5 mg/kg Day 1 every 14 days without fixed cycle count; every toxicity action blocks inferred numeric dose adjustment. Renal/hepatic guidance does not override eligibility or toxicity.

findings.before: Generic grade selectors risked being interpreted as CTCAE v5 without source reconciliation; source pages were broad placeholders.
findings.after: Clinician-confirmed source grading is explicitly labelled, with no automatic v3-to-v5 conversion. Every rule has a URL, page, section and retained PDF SHA.

findings.before: No dedicated advice-plan review was encoded.
findings.after: Contraception/fertility discussion and breastfeeding restrictions are part of the review; women are advised contraception during and up to six months after, and no breastfeeding for at least six months after the last dose.

uncertainties: NCCP initiation blood pressure >150/100 does not specify AND/OR between components. Numerical readings trigger review; clinician-confirmed uncontrolled status is assessed separately.
NCCP uses recent intracranial haemorrhage without a numerical interval; no number of days is inferred.
Grade 2–3 hypertension prompts antihypertensive therapy and consideration of interruption. Persisting grade 3 requires explicit clinical confirmation.
Source event grading is not automatically converted from NCI-CTCAE v3 to CTCAE v5.
Previous proteinuria >4 g/24 h or another source-directed discontinuation is not erased by a subsequent normal result.
NCCP expects no renal/hepatic dose adjustment, while EMA notes these populations have not been studied. Eligibility, monitoring and toxicity assessment remain required.
Concurrent discordant dipstick and quantitative results require confirmation of timing and collection validity; a current 4+ screening result is not silently overridden.
not_claimed: Browser/PDF/QR service integration completed by this bounded audit
